spans.s: धरणीधर a grammarian of the six- teenth century at the court of Udayasimha who wrote a commen- tary on the sutras of Panini which was named वैयाकरणसर्वस्व as also a commentary on the Siksa of Panini.
धर्म defined as ऋषिसंप्रदाय, the tradi- tional practices laid down by the sages for posterity; cf.केवलमृषिसंप्रदायो धर्म
. Ahnika I ; cf also धर्मशास्त्रं in एवं च कृत्वा धर्मशास्त्रं प्रवृत्तम् M. Bh. on

, as also धर्मसूत्रकाराः in नैवेश्वर आज्ञापयति नापि धर्मसूत्रकाराः पठन्ति अपवादैरुत्सर्गा बाध्यन्तामिति M. Bh. on I. l.47; (2) religious merit, cf. धर्मोपदे- शनमिदं शास्त्रमस्मिन्ननवयवेन शास्त्रार्थः संप्रतीयते , M. Bh. on P. VI.
. Ahnika l ; ' 3) property possessed by a thing or a letter or a word. e. g. वर्णधर्म; cf Kas. on

etc.: ( 4 ) the characteristic of being in a substance; in the phrase अयं घटः the dharma viz.घटत्व is predica- ted of this (इदम्) or, in other words the designation pot ( घटसंज्ञा ) is the predication; the explanation in short, can be given as घटत्ववान् इदं- पदार्थः or घटाभिन्नः इदंपदार्थ:
धर्मिन् (1)a thing possessed of proper- ties, द्रव्यः cf. धर्मशब्देन धर्मी भण्यते Kas. on
;cf also the common expression धर्मिग्राहकमानात् Par. Sek. on
: (2) the same as dharma in rare cases according to the dictum धर्मघर्मिणो- रभेदोपचारः e. g. वर्णैकं देहि, पुराणैकं देहि; cf. Durghata Vr. on
. धा tad.affix (l) applied to a numeral in the sense of a kind ( प्रकार ) or a division of time, e.g.एकधा, द्विधा, त्रिधा etc.: cf.
, 43; (2) applied to बहु to show divisions of a short time;e.g. बहुधा दिवसस्य भुङ्क्क्ते and बहुधा मासस्य भुङ्क्ते;cf. Kas. on
धारण (1) suppression of a consonant, out of two successive consonants which is looked upon as a fault of recital; e.g. ह्वयामि when recited as वयाम; ef. धारणमनुपलब्धिः Uvvata on R.Pr.
; (2) repe- tition of a consonant which is also a fault; e.g. ज्ज्योतिष्कृत् for ज्योतिष्कृत्: cf. Uvvata on
;cf. also धारयन्त; परक्रमं etc. explained by Uvvata as सान्तस्थस्य संयोगस्य आदौ रक्तं धारयन्तो विलम्बमानाः परक्रमं कुर्वन्ति where धारयन्तः means 'lengthening or 'prolonging' cf. R.Pr. on

; (3) the pecu- liar position of the mouth (मुखसं- धारणम् ) by which a double conso- nant is recited as a single one, cf. द्विवर्णमेकवर्णवत् ( एकप्रयत्ननिर्वर्त्य ) धारणात् e.g. व्यात्तम् , कुक्कुटः, cf. V.Pr.
